speaker: Mr Fadli Fawzi
text: asked the Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (a) how the peak capacity of each ActiveSG gym is determined; (b) which are the most crowded ActiveSG gyms; (c) whether there are plans to increase the supply of gym facilities where demand is high; and (d) if not, why not.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: This will be reviewed from time to time.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: Our ActiveSG gyms are generally well-utilised, with larger gyms seeing higher visitorship.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: In general, towns with larger populations have more sport facilities, including more or larger gyms.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
text: We will continue to monitor demand when planning the supply of gym facilities.

speaker: Mr Fadli Fawzi (Aljunied)
text: What are the considerations taken before the construction of an ActiveSG gym is decided on?

speaker: Mr Fadli Fawzi (Aljunied)
text: And the second one is, would the Government consider establishing ActiveSG gyms in other locations, such as shopping malls and community or community centres?

speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
text: For now, the planning parameter stays as what we will go by for our planning considerations.
